The '''Wolf Clan''' was a [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|Jedi clan]],<ref name="TCSWE" /> one of several that [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] were placed in when they commenced their [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] on how to be a successful [[Jedi/Legends|member]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> The clan's members included an orphan named [[Ezak]] and his peers [[Kiri]], [[Lartan]], [[Lina Lascol]], and [[Mox Freedan]]. Wolf Clan resided and trained in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]<ref name="TCSWE" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wolf Clan was mentioned in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', published in [[2008]].<ref name="TCSWE" />
